```{python}
#| echo: false
import graphviz
from IPython.display import Image as IPImage, display

from dih_models.plotting.graphviz_helper import setup_graphviz_style, render_graphviz_with_watermark

dot = graphviz.Digraph(comment="Commercial Evidence Flywheel", format="png", engine="circo")
dot.attr(size="10,10", overlap="false", splines="curved", label="Commercial Evidence Flywheel", labelloc="t", fontsize="24")
setup_graphviz_style(dot)

dot.node("asset", "Post-Phase-1 asset\nor treatment hypothesis")
dot.node("review", "ETRB review +\ncompliance services")
dot.node("care", "Licensed centers\ndeliver treatment")
dot.node("data", "Standardized comparisons\nproduce outcome data")
dot.node("value", "Evidence de-risks assets\nand attracts financing")
dot.node("supply", "More treatments become\neconomically testable")

dot.edge("asset", "review")
dot.edge("review", "care")
dot.edge("care", "data")
dot.edge("data", "value")
dot.edge("value", "supply")
dot.edge("supply", "asset")

png_path = render_graphviz_with_watermark(dot, "state-rtt-commercial-evidence-flywheel")
display(IPImage(str(png_path)))
```
